findings.summary: Work-title button styling is duplicated with the browse result row component.
findings.consequence: The source-download selection title button and browse disclosure title button must keep reset, truncation, pointer, hover, and focus-visible styling synchronized in two scoped style blocks; future visual or accessibility-focused changes can drift between the two row implementations.
findings.evidence: The owned `.library-work-toggle` block beginning at line 575 defines the same button reset and ellipsis behavior as `app/components/library/LibraryBrowseResults.vue` lines 246-259, and the owned hover/focus-visible color block at lines 590-593 matches `LibraryBrowseResults.vue` lines 261-264. Both components apply the same class to `data-library-work-toggle` row-title buttons.
findings.recommendation: Move the shared `.library-work-toggle` rules to a common library stylesheet or shared title-button utility class, leaving component-scoped CSS only for behavior unique to source-download selection or browse disclosure.
